classification.difficultyReason: Part a scaffolds the ordering rule, so the student only has to read the next leaf towards the stem (3) and give the digits at least 3. Part b then needs one linked step: count the repeats in the Entry row (18 twice, 23 twice), see that 23 needs a third occurrence to be the single mode, and check that 3 satisfies part a. There is one box and no trial of several cases, unlike the two-sided multi-box mode task p36-q8, which is why it sits below A4. It is a little harder than a single-skill read-off or range inference because it combines the ordering constraint with the mode condition. The diagram data is not given in the task, so this placement relies on the worked solution's description of the plot.
